description: Read stored conversion delivery outcomes, delivery gaps, retained identity presence, and journey coverage for an authorized workspace. The response uses stored data only and does not call advertising APIs. refused_before_delivery.consent counts undelivered events with consent_basis=severed_measurement, not banner refusals; other undelivered opt-outs and lifecycle events whose checkout lacked consent fall under reason_unknown. Consent rates are 0-1 fractions.

conversion_kinds.description: Conversion kinds to include; defaults to trial_started and subscribed.

from.description: Inclusive beginning of the conversion window. Defaults to 30 days before the end time.

to.description: Inclusive end of the conversion window. Defaults to the current time.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID returned by list_workspaces. Required when this credential reaches multiple workspaces.

name: get_signal_quality
title: Get signal quality
